name: Fairharbor re-engage
notes: Vic Singh, now CFO at Fairharbor, asked to evaluate Helios again. Last year's attempt is closed and in the past. New budget, new owner, new pass at a forecast process.

action_items.text: Send Vic a fresh evaluation plan and a sandbox that does not reuse last year’s workspace
Share current AE count and the board forecast calendar for the rest of the year

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Vic, good to hear from you. It's been a while. Congrats on the CFO role — I still had you as VP Finance in my head.

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: New CFO as of June. That's why I asked for time. I want to evaluate again. Last year's attempt is in the past. We passed, it was the right call then, and I am not trying to dust off that paper.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Understood. Fresh look. What changed besides the title?

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: I own the number now. The board wants a forecast I didn't build in Excel the night before. We have more AEs than we did in 2025, and the process we used when we said no last year was a founder ritual, not a finance one. I need something I can stand behind in an audit committee.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Last year the conversation died in security and a messy champion situation, if I remember. Are those actually gone, or still landmines?

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: Security is mine now, so that's faster. The person who ran it last year left. I want a new evaluation, new commercial conversation, new everything. Last year's paper is closed. I'm not trying to pick that back up.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: We can do that. New sandbox, not the old workspace. Who else needs to be in the eval besides you?

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: Our VP of Sales, Maya, and one manager. I will be in the commercial conversation because I'm the CFO. Maya will live in the weekly meeting. I don't want this staffed like a resurrection of last year with the same people who already voted no.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: I'll send a clean eval plan: sandbox, one manager meeting, then commercial. Separate from whatever 2025 was. Timeline on your side?

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: I'd like a working view before November board. If we can't get there, I'd rather not start. I'm not shopping eight vendors. I'm giving Helios a second look because we already know each other, not because I'm running a bake-off.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: I'll keep the process tight. Send AE count and the remaining board dates and I'll put dates on a plan. Anything else that would make this feel like last year in a bad way?

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: Don't send me last year's proposal with the dates changed. It's a new CFO wanting to evaluate again. That's the whole story.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: New eval, new paper. I'll send the plan this afternoon. Thanks Vic — and congrats again.

transcript.speaker: Vic Singh
transcript.text: If the first session looks like last year's deck I will say so. I want Maya to see a live meeting, not a retrospective.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Live sandbox, current product. Talk soon.
